problems.reason: The page claims Dromaeosaurus lived from the Albian to the Maastrichtian (110–66 Ma), but the species is only known from Late Cretaceous deposits (~70 Ma), making the stated temporal range too broad.

notes: - contradiction: "Dromaeosaurus lived from the Albian to the Maastrichtian stages, between 110.1 and 66 million years ago.": The page claims Dromaeosaurus lived from the Albian to the Maastrichtian (110–66 Ma), but the species is only known from Late Cretaceous deposits (~70 Ma), making the stated temporal range too broad.
